*** IMPORTANT -- STOP ALL WATCH LIST SCANS BEFORE YOU UPDATE ***
IF A SCAN IS STILL RUNNING, THIS UPDATE WILL SILENTLY ROLL BACK AND
OFFER ITSELF AGAIN ON THE NEXT CHECK -- AN ENDLESS UPDATE LOOP.
BEFORE YOU CLICK YES: OPEN THE WATCH LIST TAB, PRESS CANCEL, AND WAIT
UNTIL NO CHANNEL CARD STILL SAYS "SCANNING".

The window now minimizes to the system tray, and the Watch List scans for new uploads at startup.
